sockets.label: COOLANT
sockets.clue: The compound that fills rivers, rain and oceans.

sockets.label: CRYSTAL CORE
sockets.clue: An ionic compound sprinkled on food and on icy roads.

sockets.label: PRESSURE
sockets.clue: The gas that makes soda fizzy — and that you breathe out.

sockets.label: FRAME
sockets.clue: The compound in chalk, limestone and seashells.

sorting.label: Oxygen gas
sorting.why: O₂ contains only one kind of atom: oxygen.

sorting.label: Pure water
sorting.why: Water is hydrogen and oxygen chemically combined.

sorting.label: Table salt
sorting.why: Salt is sodium and chlorine chemically combined.

sorting.label: Air
sorting.why: Air is nitrogen, oxygen, argon and other gases mixed together, not combined.

sorting.label: Saltwater
sorting.why: Salt dissolved in water can be separated again by evaporation.

sorting.label: Iron
sorting.why: Iron is made of only iron atoms.

sorting.label: Carbon dioxide
sorting.why: CO₂ is carbon and oxygen chemically combined.

sorting.label: Trail mix
sorting.why: You can pick out the nuts and raisins — nothing is chemically combined.

sorting.label: Diamond (pure carbon)
sorting.why: Diamond is made only of carbon atoms.
